file_roles.evidence: In ProcessProbeBatch, each 'return -1' after a failed AddRow/AppendRow now first sets status_ from the stream's status(); GetNext then did DCHECK(!status_.ok()) on rows_added<0.

Mixes a NAAJ stream switch to IO-sized buffers (Partition(..., false)), a moved DCHECK and an eos rewrite. Cannot tell if the buffer change is what made AddRow fail; the AddRow error text or a failing-query status would settle it.
Only adds the use_small_buffers parameter to the Partition constructor, required by the .cc change.

rationale: The abort is the DCHECK(!status_.ok()) in GetNext, reached because ProcessProbeBatch returned -1 without setting status_. The ir.cc diff sets status_ at those returns, which is the wrong logic. Why AddRow failed in the first place is not shown.
